in_sanskrit.name: धनदीपा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who carries the light of wealth

in_marathi.name: Dhanadeepa
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhanadeepa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dhanadeepa is a name derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'Wealthy, Deep'. This name is a combination of two roots - 'Dhan' meaning wealth and 'Deep' meaning deep or vast. In Hindu mythology, this name is associated with Lord Vishnu, who is believed to be the preserver of wealth and knowledge.
